Hello @patrick99e99,

When working with Next.js, especially with file-system routing and deployment strategies, a lot of quirks usually come down to how the build output is handled (App Router vs Pages router).

Make sure your next.config.js matches your deployment target (like using output: "standalone" if you are deploying on Docker/Node instead of Vercel). Feel free to share more of your config if the issue persists! Let me know if you need more dedicated debugging here.

Hope this points you in the right direction! Let me know how it goes. Happy coding!
